Dear Birthday Girl,

I don't know if a normal "Happy Birthday" is enough, so I decided to make something a little different for you. 🌸

Whenever life gets difficult, remember that you are stronger than you think and much more loved than you realize.

Keep chasing the things that make your heart happy. Keep laughing at silly things. Keep being your wonderfully weird and cute self.

And most importantly...

I hope this birthday becomes one of those memories you randomly remember years later and smile. 💗

With lots of little hearts,
Your Friend ♡
